blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation are almost always evaluated on a static snapshot, yet the documents underlying a knowledge base continue to change. Because chunks are embedded independently, a boundary that moves after an edit forces unchanged text to be re-embedded. We measure this update cost on 120 pairs of adjacent Chinese and English Wikipedia revisions for three stateless chunkers (non-overlapping fixed-size, recursive paragraph-first, and content-defined chunking) under a strict byte-identical reuse rule and a frozen dense encoder. On the 116-article common-success pool, with frozen, length-calibrated parameters, fixed-size chunking recomputes 57-68% of its full new-version embedding-input workload, recursive chunking 38-56%, and content-defined chunking 43-54% (it failed on 4 of 62 Chinese articles), while at these parameters mean evidence recall under a fixed 2048-token retrieval budget differs by less than two percentage points within either language. A cost-only parameter grid shows that the ranking of the two content-aware chunkers changes with chunk-length settings, whereas non-overlapping fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost in every length-matched condition. Controlled edits and a verbatim-presence diagnostic support boundary drift as one contributor to recomputation of text already present in the previous version. Update cost is therefore a substantial, parameter-sensitive dimension that static retrieval evaluations do not expose and that should be reported alongside retrieval quality.
blocks.zh: 几乎总是用静态的快照来评价检索辅助生成的春king策略,但知识库所依据的文件却继续发生变化。 因为块是独立嵌入的,所以在编辑后移动的边框强力不变的文本会被重新嵌入. 我们以120对相邻的中文和英文维基百科修改为标准, 在116条共通的集合上,有冻结的长度校准参数,固定大小的块重计算其全部新版嵌入式投入工作量的57%-68%,递归式块重计算38-56%,以及内容定义的块重计算43-54%(在62条中4条失败),而在这些参数下,在2048年固定的调取预算下,有证据召回,在两种语言中均差不到两个百分点. 仅限成本的参数网格显示,两个内容意识块的排列会随着块长设置而变化,而非重叠的固定大小块在每个长度匹配条件下的重算成本最高. 受控编辑和逐字记录性诊断支持的边界漂移是前一个版本中已经存在的文本的重新计算的一个贡献. 因此,更新成本是一个实质性的、对参数敏感的层面,静态检索评价不会暴露,应当与检索质量一并报告。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline splits each document into chunks, embeds every chunk independently, and retrieves chunks by vector similarity. Chunking strategies are usually tuned and compared on a fixed corpus [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Knowledge bases, however, are revised continually, and a revision reaches the index through the chunker: when a boundary moves, the chunks on either side of it become new embedding inputs even though their words remain unchanged. In our benchmark, an English article had an atom-level edit fraction of only 0.13%, while fixed-size windows re-embedded 49% and paragraph-first chunking re-embedded 8%, illustrating substantial recomputation relative to the edit share.
blocks.zh: 一个检索增强的生成(RAG)管道将每个文档分割成块,独立嵌入每个块,并按矢量相似性检索块. 弹簧策略通常在固定体上调节和比较[1,2,3,4]. 然而,知识基础不断修订,修订内容通过块块到达指数:当边界移动时,其两侧的块成为新的嵌入投入,尽管其文字保持不变。 在我们的基准中,一篇英文文章的原子级编辑分数仅为0.13%,而固定大小的窗口则重新嵌入了49%,第1段块重嵌了8%,说明了相对于编辑份额的大量重构。

blocks.en: How large this effect is on real revisions, whether it differs between chunking paradigms, and whether lower recomputation is accompanied by evidence loss during retrieval remain underexplored for natural edits with a dense encoder. Content-defined chunking (CDC) was designed to address an analogous boundary-stability problem in file systems [ 5 , 6 ] , and text adaptations such as Steadlith [ 7 ] and KARA [ 8 ] report embedding reuse, but we did not identify a directly comparable evaluation that includes standard paragraph-first chunking on real revisions under fixed retrieval conditions.
blocks.zh: 这种影响对于真实的修改有多大,它是否在块化范式之间有所区别,以及低重算是否伴随着检索过程中的证据损失,对于编码器密集的自然编辑来说,仍然没有得到充分的探索. 内容定义块(CDC)旨在解决文件系统[5,6]中的类似边界稳定性问题,以及文本修改,如Steadlith[7]和KARA[8]报告嵌入再利用,但我们没有找到直接可比的评价,包括标准第1段对固定检索条件下的实际修改的划分。

blocks.en: We ask three questions. RQ1: How much of a revised document’s embedding input must be recomputed under fixed-size, recursive, and content-defined chunking? RQ2: What drives the difference: edit size, edit position, or boundary rules? RQ3: Does a chunker that recomputes less retrieve less evidence under the same encoder and token budget?
blocks.zh: 我们问三个问题。 RQ1: 修改后的文档嵌入输入中, 有多少必须重算在固定大小、 递归和内容定义的块下 ? RQ2: 是什么驱动了差异: 编辑大小、 编辑位置或边界规则 ? RQ3:一个重算较少在同一个编码器和符号预算下获取较少证据的块?

blocks.en: Our contributions are (i) a measurement procedure for update cost based on byte-identical reuse of complete embedding inputs, validated by hand-computed contracts and a no-edit control; (ii) a bilingual benchmark of 120 adjacent Wikipedia revision pairs stratified by edit size, with 240 questions whose version-specific evidence, when present, is anchored to character offsets; and (iii) an empirical comparison showing that, at frozen parameters, non-overlapping fixed-size chunking differs from the content-aware methods by double-digit percentage points in mean update cost while observed mean retrieval recall differs by only a few percentage points, that the cost ranking of the two content-aware chunkers is parameter-dependent, and that the diagnostics support boundary drift as an explanation for recomputation of unchanged text.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(一) 基于完全嵌入式输入的字节重复使用的、经手工计算合同验证和无编辑控制的最新成本计量程序;(二) 以120对相邻的维基百科修订对按编辑大小进行分级的双语基准,240个问题,其版本具体证据在存在时与字符抵消挂钩;(三) 经验比较显示,在冻结参数中,不重叠的固定尺寸块与内容认识方法不同,在平均更新成本中,有两位数字百分点,而观察到的平均检索只差几个百分点,两个内容意识块的成本排名取决于参数,而且诊断支持边界漂移,以此解释对未作修改文本的重新计算。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Chunking for retrieval. Recent evaluations compare chunking strategies on static corpora. Qu et al. [ 1 ] ask whether semantic chunking justifies its cost; Wang et al. [ 2 ] show that segmentation choices change downstream answer quality; Shaukat et al. [ 3 ] evaluate 36 methods across domains and embedding models; Caspari et al. [ 4 ] weigh retrieval gains against indexing and query cost as the corpus grows. These studies primarily evaluate static or single-index settings. We adopt a controlled setup with one frozen embedding model and one token budget, and ask what happens when the same document is indexed again after a real revision.
blocks.zh: 弹簧检索 。 最近的评价比较了静态体的分块战略。 Q等. [1] 问语义块化是否证明成本合理; Wang等人. [2] 显示分解选择改变了下游的答案质量; Shaukat等人。 [3] 评价36个不同领域的方法和嵌入模型; Caspari等人。 [4] 将检索收益与索引编制和查询费用相权衡,随着调查对象的增加。 这些研究主要评价静态或单索引设置. 我们采用一个有控制的设置,有一个冻结的嵌入模型和一个象征性的预算,并询问当同一文件在经过一次真正的修订之后再次索引时会发生什么。

blocks.en: Reuse across versions. Content-defined chunking was introduced for file synchronisation and deduplication [ 5 , 6 ] : boundaries chosen from local content survive insertions elsewhere in the stream. Steadlith [ 7 ] applies word-level Rabin fingerprints to text and reports reuse on synthetic edits with hashed representations; we run its pinned implementation on real revisions with a dense encoder and count exact embedding-input tokens rather than chunks. KARA [ 8 ] extends this idea to text pipelines: it retains the previous chunk layout, builds a candidate-boundary graph, and chooses a shortest path that maximises reuse of existing chunks. Its objective counts chunks and padding penalties rather than the exact embedding-input tokens we measure, and it requires the previous layout as state, whereas the chunkers we compare are stateless functions of the current version.
blocks.zh: 跨版本重用. 采用了内容定义的块来进行文件同步和分解 [5, 6] :从本地内容中选择的边界可以幸存在溪流其他地方的插入中. Steadlith [7] 将文字级的Rabin指纹应用于带有散列表示的合成编辑上重复使用的文本和报告;我们以一个密集的编码器进行实际修改,并计算精确的嵌入符号而不是块。 KARA [8] 将这一想法延伸至文本管道:它保留了先前的块布局,构建了候选的边界图,并选择了最短的路径,最大限度地重新使用现有的块. 它的目标计算成块和固定的处罚,而不是我们测量的确切嵌入式输入符,它要求以前的布局为状态,而我们比较的块是当前版本的无国籍功能.

blocks.en: Index maintenance and revision corpora. Dynamic vector indexes such as FreshDiskANN [ 9 ] and SPFresh [ 10 ] update the index once vectors have changed; our question concerns the preceding step: which vectors need to change. Revision corpora such as arXivEdits [ 11 ] , IteraTeR [ 12 ] , and ARIES [ 13 ] differ in source and alignment granularity. Our measure requires the exact bytes of both versions, and under a byte-identical reuse rule extraction noise is indistinguishable from an edit; in a pilot involving two versions of one arXiv paper, we found that citation handling alone produced spurious differences in unedited passages. Wikipedia revisions provide the exact text of both versions natively, so they form the retrieval benchmark; Sec. V adds a cost-only check on arXivEdits while retaining its extraction noise as a limitation.
blocks.zh: 索引维护和修订公司。 FreshDiskANN[9]和SPFresh[10]等动态矢量指数在矢量改变后更新索引;我们的问题涉及前一个步骤:哪个矢量需要改变. 修订公司,如arXivEdits [11], IteraTeR [12],和ARIES [13] 在源和对齐颗粒度上有所不同. 我们的衡量要求两个版本的精确字节,在一个字节相同的再利用规则下,提取噪声与编辑是无法区分的;在一个涉及一个arXiv文件两个版本的试点中,我们发现单凭引用处理就会产生未经编辑的段落中的虚假差异。 维基百科修订版在本土上提供了两个版本的准确文本,因此它们构成了检索基准; Sec. V在保留其提取噪声作为限制的同时,增加了对arXivEdits的只成本检查.

blocks.en: III Measuring Update Cost
blocks.zh: 三. 计量更新成本

blocks.en: Setting. A document D D has an old version D old D_{\mathrm{old}} and a new version D new D_{\mathrm{new}} . A chunker c c partitions a version’s text into an ordered sequence of chunks; every chunk is embedded independently with a frozen model, so the embedding input of a chunk is its exact text plus the model’s special tokens. All three chunkers studied here are stateless: they see only the current version and fixed parameters, never the previous layout, alignment labels, or questions.
blocks.zh: 准备 文档 D D 有旧版本 D 旧版本 D _{\mathrm{old}}} 和新版本 D _{\mathrm{new}}}. 一个块 c 将一个版本的文本分割成一个按顺序排列的块;每个块独立嵌入一个冷冻的模型,所以块的嵌入输入就是它的确切文本加上模型的特殊符号. 这里研究的三个块头都是无国籍的:它们只看到当前版本和固定参数,从未看到之前的布局,对齐标签,或者问题.

blocks.en: Reuse. An embedding is reused only if its complete input is byte-identical to one produced for D old D_{\mathrm{old}} under the same model configuration. This strict exact-match rule requires no alignment heuristics: two chunks that differ by a single character are two distinct inputs. The cache holds the previous version of the same document only; we do not count matches across documents.
blocks.zh: 复用诸法. 只有当一个嵌入的完整输入与D旧的D_{\mathrm{old}}}在相同的模型配置下为D_{\mathrm{old}}生产的一个字节相同时,才能重复使用. 这种严格的精确匹配规则不需要对齐的heuristics:两个与单个字符不同的块是两个不同的输入. 缓存只保存同一文档的上一个版本;我们不计算文档之间的匹配。

For chunker c c , the recompute fraction of a revision is R c = ∑ x ∈ M c T ⁡ ( x ) ∑ x ∈ U c ​ ( D new ) T ⁡ ( x ) , R_{c}=\frac{\sum_{x\in M_{c}}T(x)}{\sum_{x\in U_{c}(D_{\mathrm{new}})}T(x)}, (1) where U c ​ ( D new ) U_{c}(D_{\mathrm{new}}) is the set of distinct complete new-version embedding inputs and M c ⊆ U c ​ ( D new ) M_{c}\subseteq U_{c}(D_{\mathrm{new}}) those absent from the previous-version cache. Both sums count each distinct input once; identical repeated chunk occurrences share one embedding computation. R c = 0 R_{c}=0 means all distinct inputs are cached, whereas R c = 1 R_{c}=1 means all are cache misses. Each method is normalised by its own full-new-version input workload under this deduplication policy. R c R_{c} counts model input, not wall-clock time or price.

blocks.en: No-edit control. Chunking D old D_{\mathrm{old}} twice must yield R c = 0 R_{c}=0 ; we run this check for every document and method and treat any non-zero result as a pipeline failure rather than as a measurement.
blocks.zh: 无编辑控制. 弹出 D 旧 D 键盘 两次必须生成 R c = 0 R_{c}=0; 我们检查每个文档和方法,并将任何非零结果作为管道故障而不是测量处理。

blocks.en: Edit size. Formal token-level edit ratios require an audited character alignment that we do not yet have (Sec. VII ). As a proxy, we report the atom-level edit fraction: the text is split into atoms (words for Latin script, single characters for CJK, punctuation), and Python’s difflib.SequenceMatcher is applied to the atom sequences with autojunk=False . The matcher recursively anchors on longest contiguous matching blocks; it does not compute an optimal longest common subsequence. From the resulting matching blocks, the fraction is ( removed + added ) / ( | A old | + | A new | ) (\text{removed}+\text{added})/(|A_{\mathrm{old}}|+|A_{\mathrm{new}}|) . Moves count as a deletion plus an insertion, so the proxy overstates edits that only relocate text. Size bands (small ≤ 5 % \leq 5\% , medium ≤ 20 % \leq 20\% , large ≤ 50 % \leq 50\% , extreme > 50 % >50\% ) are defined on this proxy before any method is run.
blocks.zh: 编辑大小。 正式的符号级编辑比率需要经过审计的字符对齐,而我们还没有(第七章). 作为代理,我们报告原子级的编辑分数: 文本被分割成原子(拉丁字母的词,CJK的单字符,punctuation),和Python的difflib. 序列Matcher 应用到原子序列中,自动junk= 虚假的。 匹配器递归锚在最长的毗连匹配块上;它不会计算出最优的最长的常见子序列. 从产生的匹配块中,分数是(移除+添加) / (+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 。 。 。 移动计数为删除加插入,所以代理服务器会过度描述只移动文本的编辑。 大小波段(小\ 5%\leq 5\%,中\ 20%\leq 20\%,大\ 50%\leq 50\%,极端 > 50%>50\%)在运行任何方法之前,在此代理中定义 。

blocks.en: Retrieval quality. For each question and version, we retrieve chunks from a fixed multi-document pool with the same frozen encoder, rank by exact dot product, and pack whole chunks in rank order into a 2048-input-token budget. Evidence recall is 1 if the packed chunks cover at least one sufficient evidence set specified by the label and 0 otherwise; versions without an answer are excluded rather than scored. Annotation provenance and quality checks are described in Sec. IV and Sec. VII .
blocks.zh: 检索质量. 对于每个问题和版本,我们从一个固定的多文件库中取出块, 上面有相同的冷冻编码器, 按精确的点产品排列, 并按顺序将整块块打包成一个2048-输入式预算。 如果包装的块至少包含一个标签指定的充分证据和0个其他证据,则证据召回是1;没有答案的版本被排除在外而不是得分。 注释来源和质量检查见第四和第七节。

blocks.en: Validation. The reuse and recomputation calculations pass 20 hand-computed contracts covering insertions, deletions, replacements, moves, repeated text, and empty documents, and 13 tokenizer checks against the frozen model.
blocks.zh: 鉴定. 重复使用和重算计算通过20份手工计算合同,涉及插入、删除、替换、移动、重复文本和空文件,以及13份与冷冻模型对照的代号检查。

blocks.en: IV Benchmark and Setup
blocks.zh: 四. 基准和设置

blocks.en: Documents. We use adjacent revision pairs of Chinese and English Wikipedia articles, collected in three rounds under the same frozen rules: both versions contain 1,024–20,000 tokenizer units of body text, and each pair consists of adjacent revisions in the article history. For the frozen runs reported here, reverted, truncated, off-topic, or structurally broken candidates were excluded before the reported chunking runs. The first two rounds included raw-wikitext inspection; the larger third round used automated filters followed by two separate protocol-guided model checks. Cohort decisions for the reported runs were blind to method output; failures and exclusions remain recorded. Size bands were fixed in the released protocol before experimentation: small ( ≤ 5 % \leq 5\% ), medium ( ≤ 20 % \leq 20\% ), large ( ≤ 50 % \leq 50\% ), and extreme. In total, there are 149 pairs: 6 disjoint calibration articles, 120 primary articles, and 23 articles with unresolved source reservations retained only as a diagnostic cohort. The primary cohort has 62 Chinese articles (24 small, 22 medium, 14 large, 2 extreme) and 58 English articles (28, 12, 13, and 5); all three chunkers succeeded on 116, which form the common-success pool for paired comparisons.
blocks.zh: 文档。 我们使用相邻的维基百科中文和英文两对文章,根据相同的冷冻规则分三轮收集:两个版本都包含1,024–20,000的标致文本单位,每对作品由文章史上相邻的修改组成. 对于本文中报告的被冻结的运行,在报告批量运行之前,不包括被退回、截断、脱离话题或结构断裂的候选人。 前两轮包括原始维基文本检查;更大的第三轮使用自动滤波器,随后是两个单独的协议制导模型检查. 对所报告的运行情况作出的一致决定对方法产出视而不见;失败和排除情况仍然记录在案。 实验前的释放协议中固定了大小波段:小(\ 5%\leq 5\),中(\ 20%\leq 20\),大(\ 50%\leq 50\),以及极端。 共有149对:6条脱节校准条款,120条主要条款,23条未解决的来源保留条款仅作为诊断组群保留. 主组有62条中文文章(24条小,22条中,14条大,2条极)和58条英文文章(28条,12条,13条和5条);所有3个块块块者在116上都成功,这组成了成对比较的共胜池.

blocks.en: Questions and evidence. Each primary article has two questions (240 total, 480 version labels). A label records whether a version answers the question and, if so, one or more sufficient sets of character spans; a set may span several passages and alternatives are allowed. Human annotators assigned all 480 version-level labels based on the frozen source texts. The labels were not independently adjudicated by multiple human annotators. The questions include evidence that changes, appears, disappears, or moves between versions.
blocks.zh: 问与证. 每篇主文章有两个问题(共计240个,480个版本标签). 一个标签记录一个版本是否回答了问题,如果答案是肯定的,一个或多个足够组的字符跨度;一个集可能跨多个段落,允许其他选项. 人类注释家根据冻结源文本分配了所有480个版本级的标签. 这些标签没有被多个人类注释者独立裁定. 这些问题包括版本之间变化,出现,消失或移动的证据.

blocks.en: Chunkers. We compare three stateless chunkers, each using only the current version and fixed parameters, on the same canonical text, in which each paragraph, heading, and list item is one whitespace-normalised block and blocks are separated by a blank line. Fixed-size chunking cuts greedy, non-overlapping windows of at most 304 tokens (special tokens excluded) at token start offsets. Recursive chunking keeps a span within its 400-token target and otherwise splits it, in order, at blank lines, line breaks, and Latin or full-width sentence terminators followed by whitespace, falling back to fixed-size windows; the units are then packed greedily while they fit the target. The rules are language-independent, but Chinese terminators are rarely followed by whitespace, so oversized Chinese blocks usually fall back to windows; such blocks are rare, and in a fixed 24-article development subset 555 of 566 recursive chunks end at a block boundary. CDC uses the pinned Steadlith implementation [ 7 ] , whose word-level Rabin fingerprints select cut points that we project back onto the original text so that every chunker partitions the same string losslessly. No chunk may exceed 512 content tokens. Targets were chosen on six calibration articles so that the document-balanced median chunk length was within 15% across methods: fixed 304, recursive 400, CDC internal minimum/maximum 176/352. Parameters were then frozen. On the primary cohort the realised new-version median ratio is 1.17 in both languages, mainly because recursive chunks are the longest, or tied for longest, in 101 of 116 articles.
blocks.zh: 猎犬 我们比较了三个无国籍的块,每个块只使用当前版本和固定参数,在同一条条形文字上,每个段落,标题,和列表项为一个白空间规范块,块用空白行分隔. 固定尺寸的切口贪婪,非重叠窗口,最多304个令牌(不包括特殊令牌),在令牌开始时抵消。 递归性块将一个跨度控制在其400个托肯目标内,否则会将其分割,在空白行,断线,拉丁语或全wid句的句子句子句子句子中,后面是白空格,倒回固定大小的窗口;然后单位被贪婪地打包,同时适合目标. 规则在语言上是独立的,但中国的名词词很少会跟随白空,因此超大小的中文块通常会倒回窗子;这种块是罕见的,在一个固定的24粒子开发子集555中,566递归块在块边界上结束. 疾控中心使用绑定的 Steadlith 执行 [7], 其单词级的 Rabin 指纹选择了切点, 我们投射到原始文本上, 这样每个块块会毫无损失地将相同的字符串分割。 任何块都不得超过512个内容符号。 在6个校准文章上选定了目标,使文件平衡的中间块长度在15%以内。 参数随后被冻结。 在初级组中,两种语文中实现的新版中位数为1.17,主要原因是在116篇文章中的101篇文章中,递归区块最长,或被捆绑最长。

blocks.en: Retrieval. Chunks and queries are embedded with a frozen BGE-M3 checkpoint [ 14 ] (CLS pooling, unit-normalised, exact dot product). For each question and version, the pool contains every article in the batch in its old version except the queried article, which appears in the queried version; the pool is fixed across chunkers. Ranked chunks are packed whole, skipping chunks that do not fit, considering at most 100 candidates. Each label is scored once per chunker in otherwise identical pools, so misses count per label–chunker pair.
blocks.zh: 寻取. 断层和查询嵌入了一个被冻结的BGE-M3检查站[14](CLS集合,单位规范化,精确点产品). 对于每个问题和版本,池中包含批次中旧版本的每篇文章,但被询问的文章除外,该文章出现在被询问版本中;池在块之间固定. 排名的块是整块的,跳过不适合的块,最多考虑100名候选人. 每个标签在原本相同的池子里每个块都得分一次, 所以错过了每个标签 -chunker 配对的计数 。

blocks.en: Statistics. On the 116-article common-success pool, 464 potential version labels yield 330 scorable labels after excluding unanswerable versions (153 Chinese and 177 English). Recompute fraction and evidence recall are averaged first within each article, then across articles in each language. Paired differences between chunkers are bootstrapped over articles (2,000 resamples, 95% percentile interval). Intervals describe uncertainty in this development sample; we do not test hypotheses or claim non-inferiority.
blocks.zh: 统计。 在116-article common-success pool上,464个潜在版本标签在排除无法回答的版本(153个中文和177个英文)后产生330个可粘贴的标签. 重算分数和召回证据首先在每篇文章中平均,然后在每篇文章中平均使用每种语言。 散块体之间的差值被压在物品上(2 000个复标,95%的间隔)。 Intervals描述的是这一发展样本中的不确定性;我们不测试假设或主张非贫困.

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: TABLE I: Mean recompute fraction and evidence recall@2048 on the primary common-success cohort. Frozen parameters (non-overlapping fixed 304, recursive 400, CDC 176–352 tokens). Succ.: successful/all primary articles. CDC failed on 4 Chinese articles; those runs are retained as NA.
blocks.zh: 表格 I: 平均重算分数和证据 retrieved@2048 on the professional computing group. 冻结参数(非重叠固定304,递归400,CDC 176–352令牌). 引文:成功/全部主要文章。 疾控中心在4条中国条款上失败;这些运行被保留为NA.

V (15 Chinese, 14 English settings; a spread over settings, not an interval).
blocks.zh: 表格 二:在Sec.V的全曲速成本网格中,每个文件在冻结参数上的差异(在文档上的平均和95%的靴子间隔,百分点)和同一参数在长度匹配的参数设置上的差异范围(15个中文,14个英文设置;分布在设置上,而不是间隔).

Bands are assigned on the atom-level edit fraction before chunking (small ≤ 5 % \leq 5\% , medium ≤ 20 % \leq 20\% , large ≤ 50 % \leq 50\% , extreme above). With 2 to 28 articles per band the rows are descriptive only.
blocks.zh: 表三:普通成功池上通过编辑大小波段,冷冻参数来重算分数(%). 磁带在块化前在原子级编辑分数上分配(小 \\ 5%\ 5%\ ,中 \ 20%\ 20\ ,大 \ 50%\ \ 50%\ ) 。 每条带子有2至28篇文章,仅是描述性的。

blocks.zh: 费格。 1:平均按编辑大小波段重算分数,58条中国常见成功的主文章,冷冻参数(表三);仅说明性.

blocks.en: Update cost (RQ1). Table I reports means for the 116 articles processed by all three chunkers; Table II gives paired differences and bootstrap intervals. With frozen parameters, non-overlapping fixed-size windows re-embed 68% of the new input in Chinese and 57% in English; recursive chunking 56% and 38%; CDC 54% and 43%. Recursive-minus-fixed is − 12.7 -12.7 percentage points in Chinese (95% interval [ − 19.7 , − 6.2 ] [-19.7,-6.2] ) and − 19.6 -19.6 in English ( [ − 26.2 , − 13.2 ] [-26.2,-13.2] ); CDC-minus-fixed is − 14.4 -14.4 ( [ − 21.5 , − 7.9 ] [-21.5,-7.9] ) and − 14.7 -14.7 ( [ − 20.5 , − 9.2 ] [-20.5,-9.2] ). All successful primary article–method runs passed the no-edit control. On the full Chinese primary cohort, fixed-size and recursive chunking average 67.1% and 55.2%; four CDC failures remain NA.
blocks.zh: 更新成本(RQ1)。 图表 我的报告指所有三个块头处理的116篇文章;表二显示成对差异和靴子间隔。 使用冷冻参数,非重叠的固定大小窗口重置68%的新输入的中文和57%的英文;递归块56%和38%;CDC54%和43%. 递归-减值固定的中文为−12.7-12.7个百分点(95%的间隔[−19.7,−6.2] [19.7-6.2]),英语为−19.6-19.6([−26.2,−13.2] [26.2,-13.2]);CDC-减值固定的中文为−14.4-14.4([−21.5,−7.9] [21.5-7.9]))和−14.7-14.7([−20.5,−9.2] [-20.5-9.2]). 所有成功的主要文章方法都通过不编辑控制。 在中国全部初级组群中,固定大小和递归性块平均为67.1%和55.2%;4个疾病控制中心故障仍然是NA。

blocks.en: The differences are largest where edits are small. Among 28 small English edits, fixed-size chunking re-embeds 46% on average, recursive chunking 25%, and CDC 27%; among 23 small Chinese edits the corresponding means are 62%, 45% and 36%. For extreme edits the methods are closer (70%, 60%, 64% in English; about 92% in Chinese). The bands remain unbalanced (2–28 articles), so Table III is descriptive rather than a stratum-level estimate.
blocks.zh: 编辑小的地方差异最大. 在28个英文小编辑中,固定大小块平均重置46%,递归性块重置25%,疾控中心重置27%;在23个中文小编辑中,对应手段为62%,45%和36%. 对于极端的编辑,方法更接近(英语为70%,60%,64%;汉语为约92%)。 区段仍然不平衡(2至28篇文章),因此表三是描述性的,而不是层层的估计.

blocks.en: CDC failure sensitivity. CDC succeeded on 116 of 120 primary articles (58/62 Chinese) and on all 23 diagnostic articles; the baselines never failed (Table I ). Imputing the four failures by full re-embedding, the overall or size-band mean of successful Chinese CDC runs, or the article’s fixed-size, recursive, or larger baseline value keeps Chinese CDC-minus-fixed between − 13.5 -13.5 and − 10.1 -10.1 points with every interval below zero (full re-embedding: [ − 17.9 , − 2.7 ] [-17.9,-2.7] ), and CDC-minus-recursive between − 1.6 -1.6 and + 1.9 +1.9 with every interval including zero. The failed articles were cheaper than average for the baselines (fixed-size 48.3% vs. 68.4%), and both baselines retrieved all labelled evidence in them.
blocks.zh: 疾控中心故障敏感性. 疾控中心在120篇主要文章(中国第58/62篇)中的116篇和所有23篇诊断文章中都取得了成功;基线从未失败(表一)。 通过完全重嵌、成功运行的中国疾控中心的总体或大小波段平均值,或文章的固定大小、递归性或更大的基线值,将中国疾控中心减值固定在−13.5-13.5和−10.1-10.1点之间,每个间隔低于零(完全重嵌:[−17.9、−2.7][17.9、-2.7]),CDC减值在−1.6-1.6和+1.9+1.9之间,每个间隔包括零。 失效物品对于基线(固定尺寸48.3%对68.4%)而言比平均数便宜,两个基线都取回了其中所有标注的证据。

blocks.en: The content-aware ranking is parameter-dependent. With frozen parameters, CDC-minus-recursive is − 1.7 -1.7 percentage points in Chinese (interval [ − 6.8 , + 3.7 ] [-6.8,+3.7] ) but + 4.9 +4.9 in English ( [ + 0.9 , + 9.4 ] [+0.9,+9.4] ). As the ratio of 1.17 exceeds the 1.15 criterion, we repeated the cost measurement without retuning for all primary articles at six targets per chunker (256–496 tokens; for CDC, the maximum length), keeping the 47 Chinese articles on which CDC never failed. In the 14 English and 15 Chinese length-matched settings (median-length ratio at most 1.15 in both versions), CDC-minus-recursive spans − 2.4 -2.4 to + 6.2 +6.2 points in English and − 0.7 -0.7 to + 5.5 +5.5 in Chinese, changing sign in both languages; no interval lies below zero and 13 of 29 lie above it. For example, on all 58 English articles, raising the recursive target from 400 to 448 increases recomputation from 37.9% to 46.2% while CDC at 448 stays at 43.8%. Recursive packing can regroup downstream paragraphs after a length-changing edit, and a larger target allows that regrouping to propagate farther. Fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost in every length-matched setting, by 13.7–16.4 (English) and 6.6–16.6 (Chinese) points against CDC; 57 of the 58 per-setting intervals of its two contrasts lie below zero, and all do under stricter gates of 1.10 and 1.05. Thus, non-overlapping fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost across the tested grid, while the content-aware ranking is parameter- and language-dependent.
blocks.zh: 内容意识的排名取决于参数. 使用冷冻参数,疾控中心-减逆比为−1.7-1.7个百分点(中间[−6.8,+3.7][6.8,+3.7]]),但英语为+4.9+4.9([+0.9,+9.4][+0.9,+9.4]). 由于1.17的比例超过1.15标准,我们重复了所有初级物品的成本计量,没有按每块6个目标(256–496令牌;对于疾控中心,最长长度)调整,保留了疾控中心从未失败的47个中国文章. 在14个英语和15个汉语长度匹配设置(两个版本最多为1.15的中长比)中,CDC-减阻截面横幅−2.4-2.4至+6.2+6.2分的英语,以及0.7-0.7至+5.5+5.5分的汉语,两种语言的符号变化;没有间隔位于0以下,29分中13个位于上面. 例如,在所有58篇英文文章中,将递归目标从400条提高到448条,将重算率从37.9%提高到46.2%,而疾控中心的448条则保持在43.8%。 递归式包装可以在长度变化的编辑后重新组合下游段落,一个更大的目标可以使重新组合更深入地推广. 固定尺寸块在每个长度匹配的设定中重算成本最高,比疾控中心高出13.7–16.4(英文)和6.6–16.6(中文)点;其两个对比的58个每设定间隔中,有57个位于零以下,都在更严格的1.10和1.05门下进行。 因此,非重叠的固定大小块在整个测试网格中的重算成本最高,而内容意识的排名则取决于参数和语言。

blocks.en: External check on arXivEdits. Of 75 development papers, 63 met the frozen rules; all three chunkers succeeded on a seeded sample of 30, with mean recompute fractions of 94.5% (fixed-size), 81.4% (recursive), and 80.2% (CDC). Recursive-minus-fixed was − 13.1 -13.1 percentage points (95% paired interval [ − 21.3 , − 5.9 ] [-21.3,-5.9] ), CDC-minus-fixed − 14.3 -14.3 [ − 22.1 , − 7.6 ] [-22.1,-7.6] , and CDC-minus-recursive − 1.2 -1.2 [ − 4.5 , + 1.7 ] [-4.5,+1.7] : fixed-size chunking retains the highest recomputation fraction while the content-aware methods remain close. This external analysis checks recomputation cost only and is not pooled with the Wikipedia results: extraction noise is uncharacterised, paragraph boundaries are absent, and lengths were not recalibrated.
blocks.zh: 外部检查 arXivEdits 。 在75份发展论文中,63份符合冻结规则;所有三个块头在30份种子样本上都成功,平均重算分数为94.5%(固定大小)、81.4%(重复)和80.2%(CDC)。 递减式加固为−13.1-13.1个百分点(95%对接间隔[−21.3,−5.9]),CDC-递减式加固为−14.3-14.3 [−22.1,−7.6],CDC-递减式加固为−1.2-1.2 [−4.5,+1.7] [−4.5,+1.7]:固定式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固式加固 这种外部分析检查只计算重算成本,并不与维基百科结果集合:提取噪声无特征,段落界限缺失,长度没有调整.

blocks.en: Retrieval quality (RQ3). Under the same encoder, pool, and budget, article-macro-averaged evidence recall for fixed-size, recursive, and CDC chunking is 96.7%, 96.8%, and 95.0% in English, and 97.4%, 98.3%, and 98.3% in Chinese. Mean paired differences range from − 1.9 -1.9 to + 0.9 +0.9 percentage points; their intervals include or touch zero, with the most negative bound at − 4.5 -4.5 points for English CDC minus recursive. Observed mean recall differences are small, but the reported intervals do not rule out a recall decrease; they do not establish equivalence. These figures, and hence the cost–quality comparison, refer only to the frozen chunk-length targets; the grid measures cost alone. Fixed-size windows that share 32 or 64 tokens (about 10% and 20%) with the previous window recompute within 1.3 points of the non-overlapping windows, embed 10–26% more input, and in English recall 3.0 and 3.9 points less ( [ − 7.8 , + 0.7 ] [-7.8,+0.7] , [ − 7.2 , − 1.1 ] [-7.2,-1.1] ), consistent with duplicated text consuming the budget; Chinese recall changes by − 0.9 -0.9 and + 0.0 +0.0 points. All three chunkers retrieved every scorable label in 105 of 116 articles. Because they share labels, a label error matters only if it changes whether they agree on it; one label carries 0.4–1.7 points of a language mean, so one or two such errors could shift a difference by as much as observed; we do not rank the chunkers by recall.
blocks.zh: 检索质量(RQ3). 在同一编码器、集合器和预算下,对固定尺寸、递归式和疾控中心块进行的文章平均证据召回率为96.7%、96.8%和95.0%,英语为97.4%、98.3%和98.3%。 平均对位差从− 1.9 - 1.9 到+ 0.9+0.9个百分点不等;它们的间隔包括或触碰0,最负的绑定值为− 4.5 - 4.5分的英语疾控中心减递归. 观察到的平均召回差异很小,但报告的间隔不排除召回减少;它们并不确定等值。 这些数字,因此成本-质量比较,仅指冻结的块长目标;电网计量本身成本。 固定大小的窗口,共用32个或64个令牌(约10%和20%),上一个窗口在不重叠窗口的1.3点内重新计算,嵌入10-26%的输入量,在英语中调用3.0和3.9点([−7.8,+0.7] [7.8,+0.7]),[−7.2,−1.1] [7.2,-1.1],与消耗预算的重复文本一致;中文调用0.9-0.9和+0.0+0.0点. 在116篇文章的105篇中,所有三个块都取回了每个可粘贴的标签。 由于它们共享标签,标签错误只有在改变它们是否同意时才重要;一个标签包含一种语言的0.4–1.7点,因此,一个或两个这样的错误可以像观察到的那样改变差异;我们不通过召回来来排出块头。

blocks.en: Cost in practice. R c R_{c} represents normalised embedding-input work per revision relative to each chunker’s deduplicated full-new-version baseline. On the English cohort, moving from non-overlapping fixed-size windows to paragraph-first chunking reduces the mean from 57% to 38%; for the 28 small-edit articles, it falls from 46% to 25%. These are model-input workload fractions under a document-local previous-version cache and within-version duplicate-input deduplication, not measures of latency or price.
blocks.zh: 实际成本。 Rc RQQC} 代表每个区块的全新版基准, 相对于每个区块的普通嵌入工作。 在英语组别中,从不重叠的固定大小窗口转到第1段块将平均值从57%降至38%;对于28篇小版文章,从46%降至25%。 这些是文件本地先前版本缓存和版本内重复输入阻塞的模型输入工作量分数,而不是计量延迟或价格。

blocks.en: VI Why Recomputation Happens
blocks.zh: 六 何以复算为例

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Controlled 1% insertions at the start, middle, and end of two Chinese and three English development articles: mean recompute fraction by chunker. Cases where any chunker failed are excluded.
blocks.zh: 图3:控制了两个中文和英文开发文章的开头,中间和结尾的1%的插入:指按块重算分数. 不包括任何块器失败的情况。

blocks.en: Position (RQ2). Figure 3 isolates one variable. The same 1% synthetic insertion is placed at the start, middle, or end of a development article, and each chunker is rerun. In these controlled cases, fixed-size recomputation falls from 100% at the start to about 12% at the end: every window after the insertion shifts by the inserted length, so no downstream chunks were reusable. Mean recomputation for paragraph-first recursive chunking and CDC remains below 30% at all three tested positions, consistent with paragraph boundaries or content-defined cut points resynchronising the partition shortly after the edit. This supports a boundary-drift interpretation of the small-versus-large edit pattern in Figures 1 and 2 : for fixed-size chunking, edit position can affect recomputation beyond the effect of edit size.
blocks.zh: 位置(RQ2). 图3隔离了一个变量。 同样1%的合成插入被放置在开发文章的起始,中间或结尾,每个块重排. 在这些可控情况下,固定大小的重算从起始时的100%下降到末端的12%:插入长度的移位后,每个窗口都无法重复使用,因此下游块都无法重复使用。 第1段递归块和疾控中心的平均重算在所有三个测试位置都低于30%,这符合段落边界或内容定义的切点在编辑后不久重新同步分区。 这支持对图1和图2中的大小编辑模式进行边界驱动解释:对于固定大小块,编辑位置会影响超出编辑大小效果的重算.

blocks.en: Verbatim presence. On the 17 common-success primary articles in the 24-article development subset (Sec. IV ), we checked whether the complete text of every distinct recomputed embedding input occurs verbatim in the old version. This is the case for 50% of fixed-size recomputed input tokens in English and 47% in Chinese, for 33% and 45% under CDC, and for 12% and 37% under recursive chunking. The complete text of these inputs is present in the old version, but not as a reusable input under the old partition. This is consistent with boundary drift contributing to recomputation. The remaining inputs have no complete verbatim match in the old version; the check does not determine how much of their text would require recomputation under another partition. Because the check does not establish alignment, it supports a boundary-drift interpretation but does not quantify its causal contribution.
blocks.zh: 逐字记录。 在24粒子开发子集(Sec. IV)的17篇共继主文章中,我们检查了旧版本中是否逐字逐句地出现每个不同复刻输入的完整文本. 50%的固定尺寸的英文重制输入符和47%的中文输入符、33%和45%的疾控中心、12%和37%的递归块就是这种情况。 这些输入的完整文本在旧版本中存在,但不作为旧分区下的可重复使用输入. 这与边界漂移有助于重算是一致的。 其余的输入在旧版本中没有完全的逐字记录匹配;检查无法确定在另一个分区下需要重算多少文本. 由于检查不能确定校正,它支持边界驱动解释,但不能量化其因果贡献.

blocks.en: CDC failures. CDC fingerprints whitespace-delimited units, so a long run of Chinese text without whitespace is a single unit; four articles contained units of 403–550 tokenizer units, above the 352 maximum, and the chunker rejected these inputs rather than truncating them. This is an operational property of CDC: unsegmented Chinese needs word segmentation or a fallback splitter, which would change its boundaries and was not evaluated. Its cut points must also satisfy minimum and maximum lengths, so after an edit CDC can drift for several chunks before a valid fingerprint boundary is found.
blocks.zh: 疾控中心失败. 疾控中心指纹白空限制单位,所以长期没有白空的中文文本是一个单单位;四篇文章中包含403–550个表示器单位的单位,高于352的上限,块体拒绝这些输入而不是切换. 这是疾控中心的可操作属性:未分解的中文需要字段分割或倒置的分解器,会改变其边界,没有被评价. 它的切点还必须满足最小和最大长度,因此在找到有效的指纹边界之前,经过编辑的CDC可以漂移到几个块上.

blocks.en: VII Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 限制和结论

blocks.en: Reproducibility. Primary results come from frozen runs with recorded content hashes; the external analysis is reproduced by byte-identical replay. Chunkers never see labels, and the encoder, CDC code, and bootstrap seed are pinned. A research artifact contains scripts, per-article rows, parameter grids, sensitivity analyses, benchmark identities, diagnostic articles, and failures; article texts are identified by revision ID and content hash, not redistributed.
blocks.zh: 复次可观. 主要结果来自有记录内容散列的冷冻运行;外部分析由字节-同声重播转载. 弹簧师从不看到标签,编码器,CDC代码和靴子种子被钉住. 研究文物中包含脚本,每条行,参数网格,灵敏度分析,基准身份,诊断文章,以及故障;文章文本通过修订ID和内容散列识别,而不是重新分配.

blocks.en: Limitations. The cohort comprises 120 adjacent revision pairs from one source, and size bands remain descriptive. Chunk lengths were calibrated separately, but the realised median ratio is 1.17 in both languages and the order of recursive chunking and CDC changes across grid settings, so we make no universal claim about recursive versus CDC. The annotations were not independently adjudicated by multiple annotators, so inter-annotator agreement is unavailable; an author’s audit of 60 seeded, stratified second- and third-round labels agreed with 57, and all three disagreements were unanswerable labels whose versions contained relevant information, which removes a label from every chunker’s denominator; residual errors could still obscure the few-point recall differences. The formal token-level edit ratio and amplification factor remain unreported because the natural alignment they require has not been independently audited; we report a proxy and a verbatim-presence diagnostic. Retrieval quality was measured only at the frozen chunk-length targets; overlap was varied only for fixed-size windows. A single encoder, retrieval budget, and source were used. We did not obtain a comparable KARA run: in our probes, its token-level chunker did not reproduce the source text byte-for-byte after decoding, a 600-character Chinese paragraph without whitespace exceeded its 64-unit split limit, and its cache scope and cost model differ from the exact single-document payload cache used here. Its absence therefore limits our claims to the three stateless chunkers and is not evidence about KARA’s cost or quality.
blocks.zh: 限制。 组别包括来自一个来源的120对相邻的修订对,尺寸段仍为描述性。 Chunk长度被分别校准,但两种语言中实现的中位数比为1.17,以及跨网格设置的递归区块和CDC变化的顺序,因此我们对递归对CDC没有普遍主张. 说明不是由多个注释者独立裁定的,因此无法达成注释者之间的协议;作者对60个原始的、分级的第二和第三轮标签的审计与57个一致,所有三个分歧都是无法回答的标签,其版本包含相关信息,从每个块的分母中去掉一个标签;剩余错误仍然可能掩盖少数点的回顾差异。 正式的代号级编辑比率和放大系数仍未报告,因为它们所要求的自然调整没有经过独立审计;我们报告一个代理和逐字记录诊断。 检索质量只在冻结的块长目标中进行测量;重叠情况只在固定大小的窗口中有所不同。 使用了单一编码器、检索预算和来源。 我们没有获得一个类似的 KARA 运行: 在我们的探测器中,它的符号级块没有复制解码后的源文本字节,一个600字符的中文段落没有白空间超过其64个单元的分割限制,它的缓存范围和成本模型与这里使用的精确的单文件有效载荷缓存不同. 因此,不这样做,我们的要求仅限于三个无国籍的散居者,不是KARA成本或质量的证据。

blocks.en: Conclusion. On real bilingual revisions, the choice of chunker changes the fraction of a document that must be re-embedded by tens of percentage points, while at the frozen parameters observed mean retrieval recall under a fixed budget changes by only a few percentage points, and the cost ranking of the content-aware chunkers varies with chunk-length settings. Non-overlapping fixed-size windows have the highest mean recomputation in both languages at the frozen settings and across all tested length-matched grid settings. Practitioners who evaluate chunkers on static retrieval alone should add the recompute fraction, measured under byte-identical reuse and across chunk-length settings, before choosing a chunker for a knowledge base that will be edited.
blocks.zh: 结论。 关于真正的双语修订,选择块块会改变必须重新嵌入数十个百分点的文件的分数,而在所观察到的冻结参数中,固定预算变动下的平均检索只减少几个百分点,内容意识块块的成本排名随块长设置而变化。 非重叠的固定大小窗口在冷冻设置和所有经过测试的长度匹配网格设置中,在两种语言中平均重算最高。 仅在静态检索上评价块块器的从业人员,在选择一个块块器用于将编辑的知识库之前,应当添加按字节相同的再利用和跨块长设置测量的重算分数。
